**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/06/30 (Fri) 08:20  
[EVENT] User is planning to host a dinner party this weekend.  
[EVENT] User wants to make their mom's famous chicken parmesan for the dinner party.  
[CHANGE] User mastered making chicken parmesan last Wednesday.  
[PREFERENCE] User is feeling confident about making chicken parmesan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on mastering chicken parmesan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for preparing chicken parmesan in advance, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Prepare the breading station components ahead of time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Pound and season chicken breasts a day or two in advance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Bread chicken breasts up to a day in advance, stored in an airtight container.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Make marinara sauce and store it for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 3 months.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Grate mozzarella cheese and store it in an airtight container.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Assemble chicken parmesan a few hours in advance and keep refrigerated until baking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Bake chicken parmesan just before serving.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Label and date all components prepared in advance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Set up an assembly line for easier preparation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Encourage user to ask for help and have fun.  
[EVENT] User asked if they could prep the salad ahead of time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that salad can be prepped ahead of time and provided tips:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Wash and store greens in a sealed container with a paper towel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Chop and prepare vegetables a day in advance, stored in airtight containers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Prepare salad dressing up to 3 days in advance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended simple salad ideas to complement chicken parmesan:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Caprese Salad  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Italian Garden Salad  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Spinach and Pear Salad  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Antipasto Salad  
[EVENT] User decided to go with the Italian Garden Salad.
